The client had been training with him for two years and was convinced nothing had changed. She could recite the reasons: the weight was the same, the mirror was the same, she was tired all the time.

What she had never seen was the trend.

Weight flat. Fat mass down nine percent. Skeletal muscle up. The three numbers that had been moving in opposite directions for twenty-four months, which is why the scale had looked like a flat line while her body was doing something completely different.

He showed her the page and said nothing.

She sat with it and then said: I've been measuring the wrong thing for two years and blaming myself for it.

The tool's value there is not analysis. It's memory. A coach's memory of a client is real but it's not a chart, and clients argue with a coach's memory.

MOJOWAY's kit keeps the history in one place and draws it, so a person can see the thing their scale has been hiding from them.
